title: 13 Trapped 4 km Inside a Flooded Cave

lines.text: Thirteen people, trapped about four kilometres inside a flooded cave.
After nine days, a torch broke the surface.
The diver asked: how many of you?
A boy answered: thirteen. All of them alive.
Tham Luang cave, northern Thailand, 2018.
June 23rd: twelve young footballers and their coach went in.
Then heavy rain flooded the way out.
July 2nd: British divers John Volanthen and Rick Stanton found them.
Finding them was the easy part.
None of the boys had ever dived.
Former Thai Navy SEAL Saman Kunan was placing air tanks along the route.
On the way back, he ran out of air.
He did not survive.
The plan that followed sounded impossible.
Each boy was sedated and fitted with a full-face mask.
Expert divers guided them out, one by one.
July 8th: four out. July 9th: four more.
July 10th: the last four, and their coach.
Saman Kunan died helping make it possible.
Thirteen went in. Thirteen came out.

shots.description: COLD OPEN, frame 1 already moving. A flooded limestone passage: black, glassy water fills the tunnel almost to the ceiling, leaving a thin air gap of about 40 cm. Stalactites hang just above the waterline. Far ahead, the gap opens onto a faint mud slope in darkness. Water drips make slow rings on the surface.
shots.camera: Gliding dolly 24 mm, 20 cm above the waterline, pushing forward through the air gap; ceiling fills the top third; subtle handheld (amp 0.015).
shots.lighting: Almost black; faint cool-cyan bounce from an off-screen torch behind camera; specular streaks on the water.

shots.description: Reverse angle from the mud slope looking down at the water. The surface is dark and still; a counter ticks the days. Then a white torch beam rises from below, the surface glows green-white, and a diver's head and helmet torch break through (silhouette, mask catching the light, no face).
shots.camera: Static 35 mm low on the slope, water in the lower half; tiny push-in as the beam breaks through.
characters: diver_A Volanthen (black suit, yellow fins, sidemount, helmet torch; silhouette only)
shots.lighting: Pitch black until the torch; then a hard white beam spilling across the ceiling.

shots.description: Diver chest-deep at the base of a steep mud slope. His helmet torch sweeps up the slope across a group of 13 small seated figures (faceless silhouettes; 12 smaller, 1 taller) huddled on a ledge near the top. Silhouettes raise hands against the glare.
shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder 28 mm from behind the diver's helmet; slow tilt up the slope following the beam.
characters: 13 seated silhouettes (12 smaller boys, 1 adult coach; faceless, no likenesses)
shots.lighting: Single torch beam, warm-white, raking across mud; deep shadows behind the figures.

shots.description: Reverse: from just above the ledge, looking down the slope at the diver's torch. One by one, the 13 silhouettes are rim-lit as the beam passes over them; a counter ticks 1 to 13 in sync.
shots.camera: Locked 35 mm, slight rack focus from figures to the torch below.
shots.lighting: Torch from below as key light; cyan rim on each figure as it is counted.

shots.description: Day exterior: a steep, jungle-covered limestone mountain under heavy grey cloud; rain streaks; a dark cave mouth at the foot of the cliff with a muddy stream running out of it.
shots.camera: Descending crane 24 mm from above the canopy down to the cave mouth.
shots.lighting: Overcast, flat grey-green; cave mouth pure black.

overlay.text:
THAM LUANG NANG NON
CHIANG RAI, THAILAND

shots.description: Inside the entrance chamber looking out at daylight: 13 small faceless silhouettes walk single file into the cave past the camera, torchlight bobbing. Dry floor, a few puddles.
shots.camera: Low 28 mm on the cave floor, figures pass left-to-right in front of the bright entrance, slight follow pan.
shots.lighting: Backlit by the bright entrance; small warm torch points.

shots.description: Same passage seen from deeper inside: muddy brown water surges in from the entrance side, the waterline climbing the walls; the daylight behind is cut off as the water reaches the ceiling.
shots.camera: Low static 20 mm at floor level; water rises past the lens at the end (lens goes under).
shots.lighting: Fading daylight from the entrance; ends in darkness.

shots.description: Pattern interrupt: stylised top-down map card of the cave system. The route line draws from the entrance (lower left) through the chambers to a pin at the ledge (upper right). The flooded 'Pattaya Beach' chamber is marked just before the pin.
shots.camera: 2D card; slow 4% push-in.
shots.lighting: Graphic: dark card, cyan route, white pin.

overlay.text:
THAM LUANG
~4 KM: ENTRANCE TO LEDGE

shots.description: Underwater: a narrow, silty restriction. A guideline runs through a gap barely wider than a diver's tanks; a diver turns sideways to squeeze through while silt billows into zero visibility.
shots.camera: Tight 28 mm behind the diver, handheld (amp 0.03); the silt swallows the frame at the end.
characters: diver_B Stanton (black suit, orange fins, sidemount, helmet torch)
shots.lighting: Helmet torch only; beam scattering in brown silt.

shots.description: Back on the ledge: the 13 faceless silhouettes sit at the edge of the black water, looking down at it; a single diver's torch lies on the mud, its beam across the surface. The water is the only way out.
shots.camera: High angle 28 mm from the ceiling looking down past the figures to the water; slow crane down.
shots.lighting: One torch on the mud as key light; cold blue on the water.

overlay.text:
12 boys + their coach
None had ever dived

shots.description: Murky green-brown water. A row of air tanks clipped along the guideline recedes into darkness. A single diver silhouette swims away from camera along the row, his torch shrinking.
shots.camera: Static 35 mm low beside the first tank; long lens compression of the tank row.
characters: diver_C Saman Kunan (dark silhouette, no face, single torch; seen only from behind and far away)
shots.lighting: Dim, green-brown murk; one torch moving away.

shots.description: MID-POINT TURN. The same tank row, now empty of divers. Far down the line, the torch glow dims slowly to nothing. No figure and no struggle are shown.
shots.camera: Locked, same framing as S11 (deliberate echo).
shots.lighting: The distant glow fades to black; faint cool fill on the nearest tank.

shots.description: Black frame. The guideline alone, lit faintly, hanging still in the water; silt settles. Memorial card slides in.
shots.camera: Locked 50 mm on the line; 0.8 s held silence after the line.
shots.lighting: Near black; faint cool fill on the line.

overlay.text:
Saman Kunan
Former Thai Navy SEAL

shots.description: Pattern interrupt: 2.5D side cross-section of the cave. Dry chambers (dark grey) alternate with flooded sections (deep blue). A dotted route line runs from the ledge back to the entrance; flooded stretches pulse blue.
shots.camera: Locked full-frame diagram; slow horizontal pan from ledge to entrance.
shots.lighting: Graphic: black background, cyan rock outline, blue water fills.

shots.description: Close-up, clean and clinical: a full-face diving mask (simple clear visor, black rim, regulator) is placed over a small faceless silhouette lying still on a dark ledge, wrapped in a wetsuit. An air hose connects to a small tank.
shots.camera: Macro 50 mm, slow 15-degree orbit.
characters: small faceless silhouette (one boy, generic, no likeness)
shots.lighting: Soft cyan key, warm fill; dark background.

shots.description: Underwater: a diver swims along the guideline holding a small wrapped figure close in front of him (masked silhouette, no face); a second diver follows behind with a torch. Bubbles rise from both.
shots.camera: Side tracking 28 mm, moving with the divers left to right; slow rack to the second diver.
characters: small wrapped silhouette in full-face mask
shots.lighting: Two torches; cyan haze.

shots.description: Pattern interrupt: timeline over a darkened, blurred cave-mouth plate. Events pop in as they are spoken.
shots.camera: 2D; slow push-in 3%.
shots.lighting: Graphic.

shots.description: Night exterior at the cave mouth: work lights, rain, mud. Faceless silhouettes carry small stretchers out of the dark entrance towards the lights. A counter completes 8 to 13.
shots.camera: Low wide 24 mm from outside, stretchers emerging toward camera; slow dolly back.
shots.lighting: Hard white work lights through rain; cave interior black.

shots.description: Dawn, rain stopped. The empty cave mouth, mist drifting. On a rock just inside the entrance, a single diving torch has been left switched on, its beam pointing into the dark (generic tribute image, not a real object).
shots.camera: Slow push-in 35 mm toward the torch.
shots.lighting: Soft blue dawn; one warm torch beam.

shots.description: LOOP POINT. The flooded passage from S01, same composition: black water and a thin air gap. The mud ledge far ahead is now empty. The last frame matches S01 frame 1.
shots.camera: Same dolly as S01 (24 mm, just above waterline) so the end flows straight into frame 1.
shots.lighting: As S01: near black, cyan bounce.

loop_line: Thirteen went in. Thirteen came out.
